# Reused design sources

The homepage adapts the MIT-licensed source components below into native CSS/JavaScript. The original TypeScript sources and licenses are retained here. It does not reuse any proprietary template or marketing assets.

- GlinUI GlassNavbar: https://github.com/glincker/glinui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/glass-navbar.tsx — saturation/blur, highlight border and scroll-dependent elevation.
- KokonutUI Liquid Glass: https://kokonutui.com/r/liquid-glass-card.json — displacement filter and translucent layer treatment.
- MagicUI Bento Grid: https://magicui.design/r/bento-grid.json — responsive card layout, multi-layer shadows and hover movement.

The optical glass hero was generated using the built-in ImageGen tool. Saved project asset: `src/assets/glass-loop-v2.png`. Prompt: an isolated continuous frosted optical-glass ribbon with subtle lavender and icy-blue refraction, transparent background, white studio lighting, no text or UI.
